The Stephcakes Mobile Cake Bar

How the cake bar works

Your guests build their own dessert, and Stephcakes finishes each one right there at the cart. It’s fun, interactive, and something your guests will actually talk about.

  1. Pick a cake

    Start with a freshly baked mini cake in one of six flavors, including tres leches.

  2. Choose a frosting

    Buttercream or homemade whipped cream.

  3. Add toppings

    Pick from fruit toppings, crumbles, cereal, and candy.

  4. Finish with a drizzle

    Chocolate or caramel, added as the final touch.

We handle the setup. You enjoy the party.

Stephcakes brings the cart, the cakes, and all the sweet extras so you can relax and celebrate.

  • Interactive cake bar experience
  • Custom flavors, toppings, and styling to match your event
  • Setup and breakdown
  • Disposable dessert containers, utensils, and napkins
  • Custom banners and signage designed to match your theme, for an additional charge

Booking details

  • A 50% non-refundable retainer secures your date. Dates are booked once the retainer is received.
  • The remaining balance is due 48 hours before your event.
  • Accepted payments: Zelle, Apple Pay, Cash App, and Venmo.
  • Outdoor events need a safe, flat, accessible setup area.
  • Setup begins about 30 to 45 minutes before service time.
